decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal

1.	The retention of the existing dwellinghouse as three one bedroom flats is not considered appropriate, as the original dwelling was not large enough for conversion, nor has a family sized unit be retained.  It has resulted in the loss of a small house suitable for single-family occupation and is considered to be an over development and is therefore contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003

2.	The use of the site as three one bedroom flats is likely to generate noise and general disturbance beyond that of a single family dwelling, to the detriment of the living conditions of surrounding residents and is contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003

3.	The conversion has resulted in a shortfall of two on-site car parking spaces and is likely to lead to increased congestion, to the detriment of the free and safe flow of traffic in the immediate area and is considered contrary with policies H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003




4.	The conversion has resulted in the creation of units with rooms that do not meet with the minimum requirements of internal space guidelines.  Furthermore, the amount of communal private amenity space provided is insufficient, all to the detriment of the living conditions of the occupiers of the flats and contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003 and supplementary planning guidance.
description: Continued use as 3 self contained flats with associated parking.
